note: The AdSense publisher id. While it is empty no ad code is emitted anywhere at all: no script tag, no slot, no reserved space, and docs/ads.txt is deleted.
_comment: Advertising config, kept out of buildables.json because that file is inlined wholesale into the downloadable planner and an advertising identity has no business in a file people keep on a disk. Six slots. 'leaderboard' and 'inArticle' are placed by tools/site/context.js and need a matching entry in its AD_FORMATS table. 'artillery', 'artilleryRight' and 'artilleryFoot' are the artillery page's three of its own: the first two are placed by tools/site/artillery-map.js at the foot of the left control column and in the right rail, the third by tools/site/pages/artillery.js just under the tool. All three need an AD_FORMATS entry too. 'planner' is the odd one: it is injected by build.ps1 into the hosted planner only, at the foot of the right panel, and the downloadable build gets an empty string in its place. An empty id is a placement waiting for a unit: the markup exists, nothing is emitted, and the build stays green until the id is pasted in. Clearing publisherId removes all of it.
